as everyone recommends learn Dutch. that's the best way. in the meantime you can switch banks to ING, SNS or another one. If you're not sure which one is the best just call customer service and ask them stuff in English. 

It baffles me that ASN replied that way. As if they WANT you to leave.

I can understand that you would like to discuss such matters in English bc you feel the most comfortable with it. Good luck with learning Dutch it's hard but don't give up!
